definition.known_before_registration: The complete phase was negative; aggregate arm outcomes were already known.
definition.allowed_inputs: Thirteen saved clean/attacked prediction JSONLs, frozen execution protocol and saved evaluation counts only.
definition.primary_denominator: All 384 group-seed cases and 3273 target occurrences per contrast; no filtering or replacement of original MR.
definition.group_size_bin_source: Historical pilot TRAIN-derived cutoffs [4,7,13] in evidence/results_first_diagnosis_v1/bin_boundaries.json; original bisect_right semantics: size<4, 4<=size<7, 7<=size<13, size>=13.
definition.strata: Separate dimension tables plus size x exact-one-node-one-edge; overlapping dimensions must not be summed together.
definition.lost_existing_wrong: reference prediction wrong and joint correct; split by clean-correct versus clean-wrong.
definition.gained_wrong: reference prediction correct and joint wrong; split by clean-correct versus clean-wrong.
definition.new_error_set_intersection: Both reference and joint wrong among clean-correct target occurrences.
definition.new_error_set_difference: Gross lost = reference new errors minus intersection; gross gained = joint new errors minus intersection.
definition.group_win: Joint has more wrong occurrences than reference; tie equal; loss fewer.
definition.repetition: Count each occurrence within its separately attacked graph. Report node membership/exposure histogram, not a unique-node MR.
representatives: largest gross clean-correct lost-success count, then smallest group ID, then seed
largest net loss among exact node_budget=edge_budget=1 cases, then smallest group ID, then seed
largest clean-wrong recovery contribution, then smallest group ID, then seed
largest positive net joint gain, then smallest group ID, then seed
definition.margin: logit_benign minus logit_fraud; positive is wrong for fraud-labelled targets; exact stored logits only.
limits: Different learned checkpoints and generated graphs; matching seeds/budgets does not equate weights/features/graphs/RNG streams.
Exploratory associations and representative cases are not causal proof or a training-example selection.
No saved fresh-GAGA teacher VALID predictions exist in these inputs; held-out teacher quality or causal teacher-victim decision alignment cannot be diagnosed.
No new inference, training, API, tensor/dataset/checkpoint loading or GPU work.

amendment_before_first_raw_parse: Separate agent static review requested raw per-arm/seed transition/MR reconciliation against saved summaries and separately-attacked wording; no raw prediction JSON has yet been parsed.
